kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستوطئ (form X)
# نَسْتَوْطِئُ (nastawṭiʔu) /nas.taw.tˤi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# نَسْتَوْطِئَ (nastawṭiʔa) /nas.taw.tˤi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# نَسْتَوْطِئْ (nastawṭiʔ) /nas.taw.tˤiʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
